census.method: GitHub organization repository census plus repository-local README and manifest inspection

authority_vocabulary.canonical: sole implementation authority for its declared capability
authority_vocabulary.supporting: supports a canonical owner without redefining that authority
authority_vocabulary.incubating: experimental implementation that must graduate through the canonical owner
authority_vocabulary.conceptual: specification or concept without implementation authority
authority_vocabulary.overlapping: implementation whose boundary requires an explicit consolidation decision
authority_vocabulary.upstream-derived: fork or vendored upstream runtime integrated only through adapters
